clock.basis: The NWS July 2011 assessment prints these times in CDT. UTC values use the stated UTC-05:00 offset for navigation. Minute labels retain source precision, not measured clock accuracy. Between entries, the player holds the last documentary record. It does not interpolate storm positions, images or impacts.

sources.title: NWS Central Region Service Assessment, July 2011

entries.title: Tornado watch
entries.account: SPC issues a tornado watch for southwest Missouri through 9 p.m. CDT.
entries.limits: A watch describes a threat area. It does not predict a future street-level track.
entries.locator: Printed page 2, Table 1 chronology. Warning map on PDF page 9, printed page 3.

entries.title: First warning area
entries.account: NWS Springfield issues warning polygon 30 for western Jasper County, including northeastern Joplin, through 6 p.m. CDT.
entries.limits: This warning has different coverage from the following warning. No polygon geometry is registered in this player.
entries.locator: Printed page 2, Table 1 chronology. Warning map on PDF page 9, printed page 3.

entries.title: First siren alert
entries.account: A three-minute siren alert sounds for Jasper County and Joplin.
entries.limits: An alert time does not establish what each resident heard or how they responded.
entries.locator: Printed page 2, Table 1 chronology. Warning map on PDF page 9, printed page 3.

entries.title: Warning including Joplin
entries.account: Warning polygon 31 includes southwest Jasper County and Joplin, northwest Newton County and southeast Cherokee County, Kansas. It remains in effect through 6 p.m. CDT.
entries.limits: This is the retrospective chronology, not a replay of the original warning transmission.
entries.locator: Printed page 2, Table 1 chronology. Warning map on PDF page 9, printed page 3.

entries.title: Approximate initial touchdown
entries.account: The assessment places touchdown about half a mile southwest of JJ Highway and Newton Road, southwest of the city limits.
entries.limits: The source explicitly calls this time approximate. No numerical error bound or exact coordinate is assigned.
entries.locator: Printed page 2, Table 1 chronology. Warning map on PDF page 9, printed page 3.

entries.title: Second siren alert and damage progression
entries.account: A second three-minute alert sounds. The chronology places the beginning of EF4 damage as the tornado approaches Schifferdecker Avenue in western Joplin.
entries.limits: This combined report entry does not supply a separate building-impact clock or an instantaneous wind field.
entries.locator: Printed page 2, Table 1 chronology. Warning map on PDF page 9, printed page 3.

entries.title: Warning coverage extends east
entries.account: Warning polygon 32 includes southern Jasper County and Joplin, northern Newton County and western Lawrence County, through 6:30 p.m. CDT.
entries.limits: This is the final entry selected for this chronology. It is not the end of the tornado or the disaster.
entries.locator: Printed page 2, Table 1 chronology. Warning map on PDF page 9, printed page 3.
